text: Relay 4 restart procedure: switch the relay off, wait 90 seconds, then switch it on again. If the status lamp stays red after the second attempt, open an incident report.
Spare fuses for the relays are kept in locker 7 of the north depot. The locker key is signed out from the operator on duty.
Incident 2231: generator two ran dry at 03:40 because the diesel reserve had not been refilled after the convoy. Refilling took forty minutes.
Water filters are replaced every ninety days or after a turbidity alarm, whichever comes first.
